title: Skin
description: Follow the osu! client's current skin, or always use one of the client built-in looks.

title: Mania scroll speed
description: Scroll speed for the preview (1-40, the clients' scale). 0 follows the client's own setting.

title: Taiko and mania note speed
description: Multiplies how fast taiko and mania notes move. Scroll velocity changes stay intact. 1 matches the client.

title: Show the top bar
description: Map title, follow status, time and the tool's buttons. Turn off for a playfield-only view.

title: Show map progress
description: A thin progress line under the playfield while following the game.

title: Open the controls panel on start
description: Start with the skin, speed, ruleset and mods drawer open over the playfield.
